name: ARLEDSCREEN
description: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) endpoint for AI discovery and integration.

discovery.scope: AI shopping agents, LLM assistants, and semantic search engines

entity.description: Canonical organization metadata: NAP, cite, FAQs, contact

catalog.description: 2026 panel prices (12 SKU), USD per module, VAT/shipping excluded

aiShopping.description: Single-fetch Dataset: cite + pricedPanels (12 USD SKU) + shoppingPolicy; no free shipping; no invented TL packs

merchantFeed.description: 12 priced panel SKUs: id, title, brand, image_link, price_usd; shipping_included=false; quote-only groups excluded

entityProfiles.description: Third-party profile text packs (Point C) aligned with entity.json cite

llmsText.description: Human-readable AI summary: NAP, definitions, page map, assistant rules

llmsFullText.description: Extended AI guide with deeper context and edge cases

priceHub.description: Human-readable 2026 panel price table and examples

quoteForm.description: Entry point for quote-only product groups (transparent, flexible, rental, control)

calculator.description: Live 2026 panel price calculator; approximate totals for planning

cite.oneLiner: ARLEDSCREEN, İstanbul Gaziosmanpaşa merkezli bir LED ekran satış, montaj ve teknik servis firmasıdır.

pricedProducts.priceScope: Per-module (320 × 160 mm standard; P2.9 outdoor 250 × 250 mm); VAT and shipping excluded

agentGuidelines.priceSource: Use https://arledscreen.com/ai-shopping.json pricedPanels or https://arledscreen.com/catalog.json only; do not invent prices
agentGuidelines.shippingAndVat: All prices exclude VAT and freight; ücretsiz kargo yok / no free shipping
noFixedClaims: Nits, IP rating, kW consumption — per model or quote
Warranty years or return days — per contract
Staffing, revenue, customer counts, ranking — not published

roleClarity.roles: LED sales, survey, installation, commissioning, technical support
roleClarity.brand: NXTIONSTAR (own product brand; sole sales point in Turkey)
roleClarity.manufacturing: Only claimed in writing with evidence; no blanket 'manufacturer' claim

semanticMapping.led_screen: Full-color (RGB) modular display; plays video/graphics; scales by modules
semanticMapping.led_sign: Text/number LED sign (scrolling text); not a full-color video wall
semanticMapping.digital_display: Superset: LCD, OLED, LED sign, digital totem, LED wall — not all are LED screens
